name: cross_knot
title: Cross knot
about: A compact knot in one cord folded in half, the first layer of a four-strand crown sinnet: one face shows a square, the other a cross. Shown loose from the back, the square side, as it is tied: the two halves woven through each other in three rows, the loop at the top and both ends hanging below.

steps.caption: Fold the cord, leaving a loop at the top. Lay the right half in a zigzag of three upright bars: down the right, round at the bottom, up the middle, round at the top and down the left.
Bring the left half across the top from the left: under the left bar, over the middle bar and over the right bar, and round to the right.
Take it back to the left through the middle: under all three bars, and round down on the left.
Take it to the right along the bottom: over, over, under, and let the end hang down. Pull the loop and both ends to tighten: this side shows a square, the other side a cross.
